# fortiappseccloud_waf_template_ml_bot_detection

Configures ML bot detection for one FortiAppSec Cloud WAF template using the static template endpoint `/waf/template/{template_id}/ml_bot_detection`. This resource owns the template's module settings. To make an application inherit them, configure the matching app module resource with `template = true` and omit its `configs` block.

Declare only one `fortiappseccloud_waf_template_ml_bot_detection` resource for a WAF template.

## Example Usage

```hcl
resource "fortiappseccloud_waf_template_ml_bot_detection" "example" {
  template_id = fortiappseccloud_waf_template.example.template_id

  configs {
    status                = true
    action                = "block_period"
    identification_method = "IP-and-User-Agent"
    model_type            = "Strict"
    anomaly_count         = 1
    challenge             = "Real-Browser-Enforcement"
    block_duration        = 600

    ip_list {
      item {
        ip = "1.1.1.1"
      }
    }

    url_list {
      item {
        url = "/login"
      }
    }

    exception_list {
      item {
        concatenate_type = "AND"
        match_target     = "COOKIE"
        operator         = "REGEXP_MATCH"
        value_name       = "session_id"
        value_check      = true
        value            = "terraform-matrix"
      }
    }
  }
}
```

## Argument Reference

- `template_id` (Required, Forces replacement) — WAF template ID.
- `configs` (Required) — Typed ML bot detection configuration. Its attributes and ownership-wrapper blocks are identical to `fortiappseccloud_waf_ml_bot_detection` when that app resource uses `template = false`.

## Import

Import using the template ID:

```shell
terraform import fortiappseccloud_waf_template_ml_bot_detection.example TEMPLATE_ID
```

The first read after import hydrates all supported ownership wrappers.

## Destroy Behavior
Destroy performs a fresh GET, preserves the complete response, sets `template=false` and `configs.status=false`, sends the complete PUT, and verifies the normalized GET response before Terraform removes the resource from state.
